publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
label: 聽力 2

ex.en: 1. How will I recognize their staff members?
ex.zh: 1. 我要怎麼認出他們的工作人員？

tips.t: be recognized for 因～受到表揚（頒獎題）。
name badge 名牌；ID badge 識別證。

ex.en: 2. Did you pay for your hotel for the convention?
ex.zh: 2. 參加大會的飯店錢是你自己付的嗎？

tips.t: convention center 會議中心；attend a convention 參加大會。

ex.en: (B) No, he retired two weeks ago.

tips.t: retirement party 退休派對（Part 3/4 常見場景）。

ex.en: 6. Are you planning to go to the time management seminar?
ex.zh: 6. 你打算去參加時間管理研討會嗎？

tips.t: register for a seminar 報名研討會。

ex.en: 7. How will the machinery be transported to Argentina?
ex.zh: 7. 機器要怎麼運到阿根廷？

tips.t: transport goods by ship／truck 用船／卡車運貨。

ex.en: 9. What did you include in the job advertisement?
ex.zh: 9. 你在徵才廣告裡寫了哪些內容？

tips.t: job advertisement 徵才廣告；place an advertisement 刊登廣告。

ex.en: 13. When will the inspection team finally get their hands on our new equipment for testing?
ex.zh: 13. 檢驗小組到底什麼時候才會拿到我們的新設備去測試？

ex.en: 18. Maybe we should consider ordering from a different supplier.
ex.zh: 18. 也許我們該考慮跟別的供應商訂貨。
(B) 那不是規定一定要參加嗎？

tips.t: Attendance is mandatory. 必須出席（＝required, compulsory）。

lq.q: How will I recognize their staff members?
lq.zq: 我要怎麼認出他們的工作人員？
opts: They were very helpful.
They'll be wearing badges.
They have been stacked in the corner.

lq.q: Did you pay for your hotel for the convention?
lq.zq: 參加大會的飯店錢是你自己付的嗎？
opts: My company usually covers that.
We only take credit cards.
A convention about digital media.
zo: 一場關於數位媒體的大會。

lq.q: Why did you get back from your trip so early?
lq.zq: 你出差怎麼這麼早就回來了？
opts: Because I tripped and fell.
I'll be taking the train.
The meeting ended earlier than expected.

lq.q: Should we buy a one-way ticket or get a round trip?
lq.zq: 我們要買單程票還是來回票？
opts: I had a great trip.
Right here at the ticket counter.
We'll have to come back on the same day.

lq.q: Doesn't Mr. Norton work in the Personnel Department?
lq.zq: Norton 先生不是在人事部工作嗎？
opts: Yes, he just confirmed his departure time.
No, he retired two weeks ago.
No, I prefer to walk there.
zo: 是的，他剛確認了出發時間。

lq.q: Are you planning to go to the time management seminar?
lq.zq: 你打算去參加時間管理研討會嗎？
opts: Yes, and I learned a lot.
No, I'm taking the subway.
Yes, it sounds interesting.

lq.q: How will the machinery be transported to Argentina?
lq.zq: 機器要怎麼運到阿根廷？
opts: Based on the size of the factory.
The most efficient means is by ship.
Automatically packing boxes and cartons with machines.
zo: 最有效率的方式是海運。

lq.q: How often do you update this software?
lq.zq: 這套軟體多久更新一次？
opts: Not unless a bug is found.
Of course we do.
Usually by ourselves.
zo: 除非發現錯誤，否則不更新。

lq.q: What did you include in the job advertisement?
lq.zq: 你在徵才廣告裡寫了哪些內容？
opts: We received over 200 résumés.
The minimum requirement is a high school diploma.
Everything except for the salary.
zo: 我們收到兩百多份履歷。

lq.q: Are you able to stay late tonight to help set up?
lq.zq: 你今晚能留晚一點幫忙布置嗎？
opts: Yes, this headset will be on display.
It's still not too late to sign up.
Yes, for an extra hour or two.
zo: 是的，這款耳機會展示出來。

lq.q: Why does Patricia want to change shifts with you tomorrow?
lq.zq: Patricia 為什麼想和你換明天的班？
opts: A change would be good for her.
Because she tried to shift the blame to someone else.
She has an unexpected meeting with a client.
zo: 因為她想把責任推給別人。

lq.q: How many people are expected to attend the trade fair?
lq.zq: 預計有多少人參加商展？
opts: Over 200, I guess.
One of the speakers can't make it.
I believe it's not fair to him.

lq.q: When will the inspection team finally get their hands on our new equipment for testing?
lq.zq: 檢驗小組到底什麼時候才會拿到我們的新設備去測試？
opts: The inspector is absent for some reason.
The result turned out to be quite unexpected.
I don't have even the slightest clue.

lq.q: What's the best way to the city hall?
lq.zq: 去市政廳最好怎麼走？
opts: Try taking Oxford Street.
Around twenty dollars per ticket.
The guided tour starts at two o'clock.

lq.q: What is the matter with the new lights?
lq.zq: 新的燈怎麼了？
opts: They were installed over a month ago.
The switch doesn't work properly.
I'm going to get an extension cord.

lq.q: Who's in charge of scheduling employees' work shifts?
lq.zq: 誰負責排員工的班？
opts: Natalie works double shifts.
She said we are far behind schedule.
The factory supervisor.
zo: 她說我們進度嚴重落後。

lq.q: Do you want to let Richard know that you dropped by today?
lq.zq: 要不要讓 Richard 知道你今天來過？
opts: No, I forgot to tell him.
Sure, I will drop by at three.
That won't be necessary.

lq.q: Maybe we should consider ordering from a different supplier.
lq.zq: 也許我們該考慮跟別的供應商訂貨。
opts: No, we don't order from them anymore.
Two boxes of copy paper.
Okay, I'm open to that.
zo: 不，我們已經不跟他們訂了。

lq.q: You're going to the training session today, aren't you?
lq.zq: 你今天會去參加訓練課程，對吧？
opts: The training is scheduled for today.
Isn't it mandatory?
You must board the train now.
zo: 那不是規定一定要參加嗎？

lq.q: Shall we talk it over in the conference room, or would you prefer to stay here?
lq.zq: 我們要去會議室談，還是你想留在這裡？
opts: Thanks, I've been waiting all day.
I went to the convention last month.
It's more convenient with the equipment here.
zo: 我上個月去參加了大會。
